exposure: Guideline-based indications for umbilical cord lactate (UCL) sampling (e.g., emergency caesarean section, small for gestational age, concerns about fetal well-being in labour)
Process of umbilical cord blood sample collection and handling
outcome: Staff compliance with UCL sampling guideline
Quality/validity of paired umbilical cord gas (UCG) samples
cohort: The study included 321 babies born on or before 31 December 2021 at a tertiary maternity unit who met guideline-based indications for umbilical cord lactate sampling.
finding: Staff compliance with umbilical cord lactate sampling guidelines was generally good (87%), but the proportion of valid paired umbilical cord gas samples was low (44%).
